time.authority: Explicit scientific assessmentAt, validated/frozen by requireScientificAssessmentV1 and protected by AsyncLocalStorage equality guard.
time.grammar: Four-digit calendar year, valid ISO UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or exactly three fractional digits .sssZ, exact Date round trip. Versions pelora-scientific-assessment-v1 and pelora-scheduled-scientific-assessment-v1.
time.outerDefault: Missing independently callable outer context captures Date.now once. This is existing Task12B.1 behavior. Missing nested context rejects. Explicit malformed/null context does not default.
time.future: Existing contract accepts future assessment dates; no separate astronomy future restriction added.
time.proof: Core repeat with Date.now, Date() and no-argument new Date prohibited; default evaluations with advancing execution clocks, fixed assessment and sources; request single capture counted.
time.otherClocks: Default acquisition/cache/retrieval still uses operational clocks. They are not prohibited globally and do not enter astronomy. generatedAt differences remain snapshot/retrieval metadata in this astronomy comparison.

dependencies.location: None for astronomy: only timestamp and fixed private constants. Accepted candidate corner coordinates (15,-100),(32,-75), and (25,-90) reproduce identical moon. This does not globally qualify environmental geography.
dependencies.candidate: No ID/class input in calculation. Generated facts can be shared for identical assessment; currently copied per candidate, no architecture changed.
dependencies.captain: Inert synthetic captain/Auth/origin/range/boat/mission wrapper fields and candidate field cannot change moon. No Auth service or private store accessed; independence additionally follows sole-argument source.
dependencies.species: No species parameter or configuration read by calculation. Default returns neutral moon before current blue-marlin interpretation. Not a qualification of other species science.
dependencies.environment: No environmental values feed astronomy. Source ages independently depend on assessment; fixed source evidence across seven-day assessment shift changes ages by 168 hours. These are not lunar effects.

branches.enforcement: getOceanConditionsAtAssessment unconditionally passes assessment.assessmentAt after resolveScientificAssessmentV1; explicit null is rejected and outer omitted context captures once.
branches.counterexample: Missing outer context exercised: valid captured timestamp reaches astronomy; malformed explicit values reject before transport.

branches.enforcement: requireScientificAssessmentV1 accepts only a round-tripping UTC string; Date object rejected before provider.
branches.consequence: Default always constructs Date from the canonical explicit string.

branches.enforcement: Validated four-digit-year ISO UTC timestamp has finite Date.parse and exact ISO round trip.
branches.counterexample: Malformed, offset, precision, invalid calendar, NaN and infinities reject before transport; minimum/maximum accepted years produce finite astronomy.
branches.consequence: Standalone invalid-time return has nulls and omits lunarAgeDays/referenceEpoch; NOT a qualified default output shape.

branches.enforcement: Validated finite time minus finite private reference, divided by 86400000, has finite magnitude below 4 million days; positive finite period modulo normalization and division remain finite.
branches.counterexample: Year 0000 and 9999, exact epoch and adjacent milliseconds tested; no nonfinite result.

branches.consequence: calculated, local-astronomical-calculation, assessment-derived observedAt; status.moon calculated. Moon contributes one calculated supporting layer.
branches.oppositeEnforcement: Default getMoonConditions always returns available and populated ISO observedAt for validated context; invalid-time path excluded above. Missing source/time requires bypassing default producer.
branches.proof: Every actual default scenario asserts available; demonstrated cases assert quality calculated and equal observedAt.
